senses.gloss:
कोर कोर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. कुर्), a
movable joint, as the fingers, the knee, &c.; amphi-
arthrosis; a bud (see the next).

कोरक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a bud, an unblown flower;
the fibres of the stalk of a lotus; a species of perfume,
commonly Cor (चोर); another perfume, a berry
containing a resinous and fragrant substance; [cf.
कक्कोलक.]
कोरकित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with buds.

कोरित, अस्, आ, अम्, budded, sprouted; ground,
pounded, comminuted.

कोरङ्गी कोरङ्गी, f. small cardamoms; [cf.
एला.]

कोरदूष कोर-दूष or कोरदूषक, अस्, m.
a kind of grain eaten especially by the poor, Paspalum
Scrobiculatum. See कोद्रव.
कोरली कोरली or कोरिला, f., N. of a town.
